notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); roll-forward uses fund balance 2,494,466 to 2,172,503 as cash. Transfers in 50,000 / out 105,000 are net of the 125,000 elimination (Eliminations column removes 125,000 from both Operation and Maintenance of Plant disbursements and transfers in; total column already net). Bond Proceeds 3,000,000 = debt_proceeds; Bond Issuance Costs (51,745) = other_financing. 'Other' local receipts 46,851 split using the General Fund budget schedule (Public Power District Sales Tax 13,741 + Miscellaneous Local Receipts 33,110, p8). Miscellaneous 1,007,448 split by fund schedules into Special Building 530,320, Employee Benefit 342,328 and Activities Fund receipts 134,800. Operation and Maintenance of Plant 4,564,327 split by fund column into capital outlay 4,188,621 (Special Building 4,003,391 + Depreciation 185,230) and support services 375,706. Students 471,958 split by fund column into support services 262,414 (General) and student activities 209,544 (Other Governmental = Activities Fund disbursements). Printed report discrepancy: Property and Carline Taxes line is 1 higher than the fund columns (see report_discrepancies); receipt lines sum 5,171,909 vs printed total 5,171,908, so the roll-forward is 1 off. Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (p7): operating receipts 20,916 + nonoperating USDA and State Subsidy 102,897 = 123,813 (added up, no single total printed); transfers in 55,000; 66,728 + 123,813 - 201,989 + 55,000 = 43,552. Balance sheet from the Statement of Net Position (p1) Totals column; no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from the p8 budget schedule; General Fund disbursements from the more detailed Budgetary Schedule of Disbursements (p10-11), so the p9 function-level table is not repeated except the transfers; zero-actual lines skipped. The 125,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund is hidden inside General Fund O&M lines (see contra line). Activity Fund recorded account by account from the complete per-account schedule (pp18-19: Athletics, Academics, District, Classes; Pop Fund and zero-activity accounts have no current-year activity) instead of the one-line p17 budget schedule; transfers in by account total 50,000 (p19), matching the General Fund transfer to Activities Fund.
